title.zh: 将莱特省马哈普拉格市镇的卡伦扬、伊哈万、卡格西利汉、蒙特里科与塔格比诺加小村组建为该市镇名为圣胡安村的法案
title.en: An Act Constituting Sitios Calunyan, Ihawan, Kagsilihan, Monterico and Tagbinonga in the Municipality of Mahaplag, Province of Leyte, Into a Barrio of Said Municipality, to Be Known as Barrio San Juan
title.orig: An Act Constituting Sitios Calunyan, Ihawan, Kagsilihan, Monterico and Tagbinonga in the Municipality of Mahaplag, Province of Leyte, Into a Barrio of Said Municipality, to Be Known as Barrio San Juan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5569_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Sitios Calunyan, Ihawan, Kagsilihan, Monterico and Tagbinonga in the Municipality of Mahaplag, Province of Leyte, are hereby constituted into a barrio of said municipality to be known as Barrio San Juan.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
